messages:
nina: spotted a KMS-wrapped blob in a partner onboarding tarball (s3://onboard-archive/2026-03-21/upload.tgz). moving to quarantine and flagging sec.

raj: can you share the blob filename and header hint (redacted)? also which KMS key is referenced?

nina: filename: onboarding/secret_blob.enc. header shows `gcp_kms|projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/onboard/cryptoKeys/onboard-wrap|v1`  truncated. looks like our CMK.

claire: P2 until we confirm. action: (1) copy to sec-quarantine, (2) export object access logs 30d, (3) query KMS decrypt audit for that key.

ops-bot: [AUTO] rule=artifact_kms_blob_detected; confidence=0.79; recommended=quarantine+audit

nina: quarantine copy done: `aws s3 cp s3://onboard-archive/2026-03-21/upload.tgz s3://sec-quarantine/6326009999-upload.tgz` (will not unpack outside secure project).

raj: running logs now: `aws s3api get-bucket-logging --bucket onboard-archive` and CloudTrail filter for `Decrypt` events against `onboard-wrap`. will update ticket INC-2026-073.

claire: on RBAC: prepare a temporary scoped deny on `s3:GetObject` for `role/partner-ingest` for the archive prefix. we should avoid broad denies. I'll draft JSON.

marta: question: do we rotate the CMK or ask partner to rotate inner credential? if our CMK was used to wrap, we must at least create new key version and disable decrypt on old key while forensics proceed.

raj: logs show one Decrypt call three days ago from `serviceAccount:partner-ci@partners.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. no other external principals. blast radius limited.

nina: good to know. still proceed with rekey: create new key version, rewrap copies in quarantine, and disable decrypt on old version. I'll own the quarantine rewrap.

claire: RBAC patch posted to INC-2026-073 for 2hr window; scheduled 02:00-04:00 PT to minimize impact. include rollback to re-enable quickly.

marta: draft partner notification: "We detected a KMS-wrapped artifact that references a Redwood-managed key. We've quarantined the object and are rotating access. Please rotate any credentials in that artifact and confirm." send via partner-ops.

raj: checksum snapshot: sha256=4bd3f2... saved in the ticket. forensic artifact attached.

nina: rewrap plan: run secure job that decrypts (in secure env) with new key version and writes rewrapped blob to sec-quarantine. script will run under a locked CI job.

ops-bot: [AUTO] checklist appended to INC-2026-073: quarantine-copy, export-logs, create-key-version, disable-old-decrypt, rewrap-artefacts, partner-notify, postmortem.

claire: who will own the postmortem? alex or marta? marta: please.

marta: happy to own postmortem. target: mitigations today, sweep and rewrap by EOD, postmortem in 48h.

nina: assigning tasks in the ticket: nina -> quarantine + checksum, raj -> audit logs + decrypt query, claire -> RBAC patch, marta -> partner comms + postmortem owner.

raj: running final checks now. will update when logs exported.

nina: thanks team. will update INC-2026-073 as things progress. :thumbsup:
